p(lambda) = lambda * p_inside + (1 - lambda) * p_hat on the base cell's menus; p_inside = 1/|D| on every observed cell. lambda = 0 is the stored base reference. Cells whose distance is ~0 are certified by an absolute criterion (see the `criterion` field of the reference).
